entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I pushed open the large doors to th..."
entries.dialogueText: I pushed open the large doors to the War Room and stepped inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The military helicopter gracefully..."
entries.dialogueText: The military helicopter gracefully landed on the helipad.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see the pillars of smoke fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see the pillars of smoke from the air during the flight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the engine stopped, my ears were..."
entries.dialogueText: As the engine stopped, my ears were still ringing from the loud noise.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I fixed the collar of my old army u..."
entries.dialogueText: I fixed the collar of my old army uniform, feeling comfortable in it. This whole trip reminded me of the good old days at Camp Domus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A soldier opened the door and led m..."
entries.dialogueText: A soldier opened the door and led me toward a long line of his compatriots, where General Taddeus Azaro and General Carlos Azaro were both waiting for me. They were surrounded by numerous cameras.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""ATTENTION!""
entries.dialogueText: "ATTENTION!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of the soldiers simultaneously..."
entries.dialogueText: All of the soldiers simultaneously turned and saluted me. The sound of their boots cut through the helicopter's slowing propeller.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I trust the skies were kind to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust the skies were kind to you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you for accepting our reques..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for accepting our request, my liege. Welcome to FOB Bull Charge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a pleasure to be here. I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a pleasure to be here. I've been wanting to see the front lines with my own eyes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Skip the pleasantries, General Aza..."
entries.dialogueText: "Skip the pleasantries, General Azaro. We have much to discuss."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Everything will be discussed, as p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything will be discussed, as planned, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would much rather be in Porte Dr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would much rather be in Porte Drazon right now. I hope this meeting is worth my time."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I'm glad to hear it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My daughter will be arriving after..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter will be arriving after dinner. But for now..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do hope that you did not put you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope that you did not put your King in danger by forcing me to come here."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It will be, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It will be, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We have taken every precaution, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have taken every precaution, Your Majesty. You have nothing to fear."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""This way, Your Majesty. You must b..."
entries.dialogueText: "This way, Your Majesty. You must be hungry after your trip. We have already prepared your quarters."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was right. Pride was written all..."
entries.dialogueText: He was right. Pride was written all over their faces.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""GLOVURIUS AXA RIZIA!""
entries.dialogueText: "GLOVURIUS AXA RIZIA!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers joined in and chanted..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers joined in and chanted the words in unison.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will dine together with the sold..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will dine together with the soldiers in the barracks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Invite this soldier to dine with u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Invite this soldier to dine with us, General."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured toward a tent. Inside,..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured toward a tent. Inside, there was a lavish table piled high with an outrageous amount of food, reserved only for nobility.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We went down the line, conducting a..."
entries.dialogueText: We went down the line, conducting a thorough inspection. I shook hands and saluted until I lost count.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After saluting, I shook hands with..."
entries.dialogueText: After saluting, I shook hands with them. I leaned forward so only they could hear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned toward his troops and sal..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned toward his troops and saluted them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wasn't sure if it was my imaginat..."
entries.dialogueText: I wasn't sure if it was my imagination, but I thought I heard a gulp from the soldier standing behind me. He was a mere boy, barely out of his teens, all skin and bones.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would have preferred a tableclot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have preferred a tablecloth, but I suppose this is acceptable. Very well. Let's get on with it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We sat at the table, where the two..."
entries.dialogueText: We sat at the table, where the two generals gave a brief but comprehensive update on the base’s operations.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tried to stomach the terrible foo..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to stomach the terrible food. It was perhaps the worst meal of my life, but I persevered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos nodded in assent and led me..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos nodded in assent and led me to the barracks, where dinner was just now being served. The soldiers gaped in awe as their king sat to eat with them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rest of the dinner was rather u..."
entries.dialogueText: The rest of the dinner was rather uneventful. I talked about my own time in the military, getting a few laughs from the stories I told.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rest of the dinner was rather u..."
entries.dialogueText: The rest of the dinner was rather uneventful. I listened to a few stories from the battlefield.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos nodded his assent and gestur..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos nodded his assent and gestured for the boy to enter the tent with us. He gaped in awe as he sat to eat next to his king.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There were tears in his eyes as he..."
entries.dialogueText: There were tears in his eyes as he tore into his meal, proclaiming it the best food he'd ever tasted in his life.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the meal, a soldier came by t..."
entries.dialogueText: After the meal, a soldier came by to let us know that Duchess Azaro had arrived. We moved to another tent.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Take a look around. Morale is at i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take a look around. Morale is at its peak -- higher than it’s been in months. The men are energized, eager to have their king with them."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty. Father. General Carl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Father. General Carlos."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that you're here, we can begin.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you're here, we can begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank God. I was about to die from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God. I was about to die from boredom. General?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Proceed."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As you wish, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Cameras went off with blinding flas..."
entries.dialogueText: Cameras went off with blinding flashes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My kingdom was on fire."
entries.dialogueText: My kingdom was on fire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The military helicopter touched dow..."
entries.dialogueText: The military helicopter touched down on the helipad as a few medical helicopters took off and another landed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A soldier opened the door and salut..."
entries.dialogueText: A soldier opened the door and saluted immediately. His eyes were blank, looking but not actually seeing. They were the eyes of someone who had seen hell.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus Azaro and General C..."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus Azaro and General Carlos Azaro were both seated around a table along with a number of other high-ranking officers, arguing loudly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the protocols, Carlos approac..."
entries.dialogueText: After the protocols, Carlos approached.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The last man in line towered over a..."
entries.dialogueText: The last man in line towered over all the others. He was at least two meters tall, with a number of scars on his face.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""This is Major Tigris. Hero of Fort..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is Major Tigris. Hero of Fort Ales. He single-handedly eliminated 32 enemy combatants. A record."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""One of the best men I've ever seen..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of the best men I've ever seen in all my days in the army."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I held out my hand so that he could..."
entries.dialogueText: I held out my hand so that he could kiss my ring.
entries.menuText: Gesture for him to kiss your ring.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I put my hand on his head and said..."
entries.dialogueText: I put my hand on his head and said a prayer.
entries.menuText: Place your hand on his head and say a prayer.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On your feet, soldier. You bow bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "On your feet, soldier. You bow before no one. Thank you for your service."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The giant knelt before me obedientl..."
entries.dialogueText: The giant knelt before me obediently.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This honor was granted to very few..."
entries.dialogueText: This honor was granted to very few people in the military. He kissed the ring in great disbelief, then rose to his feet with a wholehearted salute.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was taken aback and looked cauti..."
entries.dialogueText: He was taken aback and looked cautiously at Taddeus. After a nod of confirmation from the general, he got up and saluted me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He repeated the prayer, then rose t..."
entries.dialogueText: He repeated the prayer, then rose to his feet with a wholehearted salute.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I expect nothing less from our mil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect nothing less from our military. Everyone here should strive to be like him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He got up on his feet and saluted w..."
entries.dialogueText: He got up on his feet and saluted wholeheartedly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A scream cut through his words. A s..."
entries.dialogueText: A scream cut through his words. A soldier on a stretcher was crying out for his mother as he was moved into a medical helicopter. He was covered in bloody bandages.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus and Carlos continued arguin..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus and Carlos continued arguing, seemingly unfazed by the scream. However, when a soldier whispered in their ear regarding my arrival, they quickly assumed a professional demeanor.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Ah. My liege. Thank you for accept..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. My liege. Thank you for accepting our request. Welcome to FOB Iron Gate."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I trust the skies were kind to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust the skies were kind to you, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After saluting, I shook hands with..."
entries.dialogueText: After saluting, I shook hands with them. I leaned forward so only they could hear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do hope that you did not put you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope that you did not put your King in danger by forcing me to come here."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We have taken every precaution, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have taken every precaution, Your Majesty. You have nothing to fear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wanted to see the frontline with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to see the frontline with my own eyes. Or whatever you call this mess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Skip the pleasantries, General Aza..."
entries.dialogueText: "Skip the pleasantries, General Azaro. We have much to discuss."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes, Your Majesty..""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty.."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You couldn't put together a proper..."
entries.dialogueText: "You couldn't put together a proper welcome party?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I am sorry, Your Majesty. We were..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Your Majesty. We were in the middle of a strategic discussion."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Duchess Azaro will be arriving sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro will be arriving shortly. But for now..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Take a look around. Morale is at i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take a look around. Morale is at its peak -- higher than it’s been in months. The men are energized, eager to have their king with them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I cast my eye over the bedraggled g..."
entries.dialogueText: I cast my eye over the bedraggled group of soldiers. Most of them seemed too tired to have even registered my presence.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""GLOVURIUS AXA RIZIA!""
entries.dialogueText: "GLOVURIUS AXA RIZIA!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus turned and saluted the sold..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus turned and saluted the soldiers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few meek shouts rose from the sol..."
entries.dialogueText: A few meek shouts rose from the soldiers. Most of them continued with their duties, transporting sandbags and injured compatriots.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus halted two soldiers rushing..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus halted two soldiers rushing to transport a wounded man on a stretcher. The soldier's height made him nearly too large for it, and his injuries left little hope -- he wouldn't last much longer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus held his hand and said a pr..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus held his hand and said a prayer. The man let out a final sigh. His fellow soldiers continued carrying him, slower than before.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I remember when he first joined my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember when he first joined my battalion. He kept showing everyone photos of his daughter..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As you say, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you say, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't blame yourself. This is not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't blame yourself. This is not your fault. It is mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is entirely your fault. If on..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is entirely your fault. If only these soldiers had a better general leading them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My condolences. I am sure he was a..."
entries.dialogueText: "My condolences. I am sure he was an excellent soldier."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""God damn it! That was Major Tigris..."
entries.dialogueText: "God damn it! That was Major Tigris! One of the best men I've seen in all my days in the army."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His death will be avenged, General..."
entries.dialogueText: "His death will be avenged, General Azaro. I promise."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty, but I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty, but I cannot let you speak ill of yourself. My honor won't allow it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""He was, Your Majesty. He was.""
entries.dialogueText: "He was, Your Majesty. He was."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I told you that the left flank is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you that the left flank is no-go!"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Nevertheless, your presence here i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nevertheless, your presence here is already helping with our situation."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Look around at these men. They're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look around at these men. They're prepared to fight for their country to their final breath."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was right. They looked at me wit..."
entries.dialogueText: He was right. They looked at me with hope in their eyes. Despite everything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sons and daughters of Rizia. Do no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sons and daughters of Rizia. Do not falter! We will be victorious! No matter what!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Times may be tough. But know this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Times may be tough. But know this, your sacrifices for our country will never be in vain."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you for your encouraging wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your encouraging words, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fear not. Fight for your King. Fig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fear not. Fight for your King. Fight for your country!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shall all return to the bosom o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall all return to the bosom of our God one way or another. May it be with pride and honor!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The tired soldiers got up on their..."
entries.dialogueText: The tired soldiers got up on their feet. They saluted and started chanting in weary voices.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Weary, but loud and clear."
entries.dialogueText: Weary, but loud and clear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A soldier came by to let us know th..."
entries.dialogueText: A soldier came by to let us know that Duchess Azaro had arrived.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Right this way, sire.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right this way, sire."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We moved to the briefing room."
entries.dialogueText: We moved to the briefing room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus Azaro and General C..."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus Azaro and General Carlos Azaro were there, deep in conversation with a few high-ranking officers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They all turned to me and saluted."
entries.dialogueText: They all turned to me and saluted.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Good evening, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good evening, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I just returned from the frontline..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just returned from the frontline today, bearing news."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My daughter will arrive shortly.""
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter will arrive shortly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As if on cue, the doors swung open..."
entries.dialogueText: As if on cue, the doors swung open and Lucita walked in.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that you are here, we can begi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you are here, we can begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Proceed."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As you wish, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""General Azaro, please start.""
entries.dialogueText: "General Azaro, please start."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her medals bumped against my chest..."
entries.dialogueText: Her medals bumped against my chest as she leaned in for a kiss.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She clasped her arms around my neck..."
entries.dialogueText: She clasped her arms around my neck and whispered into my ear.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Except...""
entries.dialogueText: "Except..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""For every hair they touch on her h..."
entries.dialogueText: "For every hair they touch on her head, I'll kill a dozen of them myself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita stepped back and took a last..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita stepped back and took a last fond look at me before running to join her father.

entries.dialogueText: Her expression grew determined.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Princess is at the forefront o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Princess is at the forefront of all of our minds. We won't rest until she's found."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Luce. I don't know what..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Luce. I don't know what came over me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It was your right to discipline hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was your right to discipline him. Two major losses in two wars against Pales is unforgivable."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I'm begging you, Romus. Leave..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm begging you, Romus. Leave us Azaros to handle our own affairs. Don't bring more public disgrace to our house."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She squeezed my hand and shook her..."
entries.dialogueText: She squeezed my hand and shook her head sadly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a sad last look at me befo..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a sad last look at me before running to join her father.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have to win this, Luce. I can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have to win this, Luce. I can't afford a loss."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A grim look of determination spread..."
entries.dialogueText: A grim look of determination spread on her face.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll do whatever it takes, Romus...."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll do whatever it takes, Romus. Just trust in your military."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave my hand a quick squeeze be..."
entries.dialogueText: She gave my hand a quick squeeze before running out to join her father.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""For every hair they touch on her h..."
entries.dialogueText: "For every hair they touch on her head, I'll kill a dozen of them. Personally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're dismissed, Councilor.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're dismissed, Councilor."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of-- of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of-- of course."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm sorry we failed you, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry we failed you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give it to me straight. How screwe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give it to me straight. How screwed are we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Star of Valor was Rizia’s highe..."
entries.dialogueText: The Star of Valor was Rizia’s highest military honor.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Well, if you had listened to my ad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if you had listened to my advice in the first place-"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I stand with Taddeus. This is not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand with Taddeus. This is not your doing."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I stand by Taddeus in this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand by Taddeus in this, Your Majesty. We are both accountable for what has transpired."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty. Father. General Carl..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
